title: Randy Johnson 1997 Topps #325 Baseball Card Mariners
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1997 Topps #325 baseball card featuring Randy Johnson of the Seattle Mariners. It is a part of the base set and has not been autographed. The card is suitable for collectors who are fans of the Major League Baseball and the Seattle Mariners. The card number is 325 and it is a sports trading card of the type "Sports Trading Card". The manufacturer of the card is Topps and it is a part of the 1997 season.
